name: Nightwalker
description: Supernatural Virtue shared by all nightwalker traditions, granting ekstasis (straying) and requiring participation in fertility battles.

name: Nightwalkers
description: Hedge magicians who send their spirits forth while unconscious to fight fertility battles and patrol their communities against evil.

name: Ghost
description: Virtue for nightwalkers who, dying while their phantasticum is absent, wander the world as ghosts until their destined hour of death.

name: Greater Purifying Touch
description: Supernatural power some nightwalker healers possess that mitigates the effects of Infernal attack.

name: Sense Holiness and Unholiness
description: Ability nightwalkers use to detect foes while awake and to find curse anchors placed by Infernal witches.

name: Caul
description: Hood of membrane with which most nightwalkers are born; kept by the nightwalker and in some traditions the source of his powers, granting caul-based Virtues.

name: Immunity to Drowning
description: Major Virtue granted by a caul; the character floats unconscious to shore rather than drowning.

name: Luck
description: Minor Virtue that may be granted by possessing a caul.

name: Self-Confidence
description: Minor Virtue that may be granted by possessing a caul.

name: Strong-Willed
description: Minor Virtue that may be granted by possessing a caul.

name: Dowsing
description: Minor Virtue often granted to those born with a caul.

name: Second Sight
description: Supernatural Ability available to a nightwalker's phantasticum, used to find dangerous creatures, cursed objects and foes in phantastic form.

name: Weather Sense
description: Minor Virtue granting an intuitive understanding of the weather, identical in effect to Sailor's Foretaste of the Morrow, without a roll.

name: Sailor's Foretaste of the Morrow
description: Hermetic spell for predicting weather, whose effect the Weather Sense Virtue duplicates.

name: Compulsion
description: Flaw common among nightwalkers (e.g. to fight the battle in waking life); Rothiger has a compulsion to kill in wolf form.

name: Dark Secret
description: Flaw common among nightwalkers, e.g. living in a community that persecutes nightwalkers as infernalists.

name: Dependent
description: Flaw common among nightwalkers.

name: Diabolic Past
description: Flaw for nightwalkers who have changed sides from evil, possible but difficult in most traditions.

name: Dutybound
description: Flaw common among nightwalkers, bound to the night battles.

name: Enemies
description: Flaw common among nightwalkers, such as a local Infernal witch.

name: Higher Purpose
description: Flaw common among nightwalkers, such as fighting evil.

name: Nocturnal
description: Flaw common among nightwalkers.

name: Oath of Fealty
description: Flaw common among nightwalkers, sworn to the group's supernatural patron.

name: Plagued by Supernatural Entities
description: Flaw for nightwalkers or intervening magi harassed by demons seeking revenge or the dead seeking rest.

name: Supernatural Nuisance
description: Flaw common among nightwalkers, similar to Plagued by Supernatural Entities.

name: Ekstasis
description: The magical power defining nightwalker traditions, also called straying, which lets a magician send forth his spirit while unconscious; it has no corresponding Ability.

name: Call to Slumber
description: Hermetic spell magi can use to render themselves or others insensible in order to stray.

name: Infernal Witches
description: Servants of the Infernal who curse villages and battle nightwalkers in the night battles, often as the malandanti.

name: Sabbat
description: Infernal gathering that witches attend using a demon-provided ointment similar to that of nightwalkers.

name: Aristotle
description: Ancient philosopher who recorded Greek magicians who spent years in a semblance of death while straying.

name: Laplander Nightwalkers
description: Nightwalker tradition whose members die if their insensate bodies are simply touched.

name: Phantasticum
description: The spiritual yet corporeal form that strays from a nightwalker's body, able to become corporeal, immaterial or invisible and to take human or animal shape.

name: Hounds of God
description: Werewolf nightwalkers charged with besieging Hell to recapture stolen seeds; they pass their power by a toasting ritual, mostly among German-speaking settlers.

name: Long Term Fatigue
description: Fatigue lost by nightwalkers after straying, recovered faster through spiritual nourishment and feasts.

name: Spirit Travel
description: Near-instant travel by a nightwalker's phantasticum, requiring a Stamina + Athletics roll by familiarity with the destination.

name: Venice
description: City above which a militia of nightwalkers (benandanti) fights, over Saint Mark's Square.

name: Adriatic
description: Sea across which the Venetian nightwalker militia floats in swift eggshells.

name: Saint Mark's Square
description: Square in Venice above which a benandanti militia meets its rivals in immaterial form.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Magical link to a target; allows automatic spirit travel and is created by vitkar runes and kolossoi.

name: True Love
description: A nightwalker automatically succeeds in spirit travel to his or her True Love.

name: Versatile Phantasticum
description: Virtue letting a nightwalker use an animal phantasticum outside fertility battles and spend experience on animal-form Abilities.

name: Missing Eye
description: Example of a bodily Flaw that also applies to a nightwalker's animal form.

name: Order of Odin
description: Magi's name for an imagined organized group of Scandinavian rune wizards (vitkir) opposed to the Order of Hermes, dating from the war against Damhan-Allaidh.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of Hermetic magi, which employs nightwalkers as guards and scouts and considers itself at war with the Order of Odin.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Protection against supernatural effects; affects drowsiness from phantastica and resistance to rune spells.

name: Fertility Battles
description: Battles in spirit form that nightwalkers fight, usually four times a year, determining the harvest, hunting and fishing of their area.

name: Malandanti
description: The 'bad walkers', evil nightwalkers (usually Infernal witches, sometimes unruly ghosts) who oppose the benandanti, fighting with sorghum.

name: Mazzeri
description: Corsican nightwalker tradition that fights with asphodel and is compelled to hunt in dreams, killing animals representing villagers destined to die.

name: Taltós
description: Hungarian nightwalkers, remnants of Magyar shamans, who fight in the sky as horses, bulls or flames and can cause storms.

name: Benandanti
description: The 'good walkers' of Northern Italy who fight Infernal witches on the Thursdays of the Ember Days, armed with fennel.

name: Noheir
description: German dead who are ghosts of people born with cauls, with higher Might and greater persistence and destructiveness.

name: Tempters
description: Weak class of demons that nightwalkers commonly face, serving a human malandanti captain.

name: Aerial Powers
description: Class of demons; most demonic captains of night battles are Aerial Powers of Might 20 or less.

name: Elementals
description: Magical beings whose statistics can represent enemies in elemental shape and the taltós flame form.

name: Captain of the Nightwalkers
description: Leader of a nightwalker host, chosen by its supernatural patron, often marked by a pennant on the battlefield.

name: Processions of the Dead
description: Nightwalker processions along the Ways of the Dead with the recently departed, keeping the ways clear and regulating the unquiet dead.

name: Ways of the Dead
description: Routes traveled by the spirits of the recently departed, kept clear by nightwalker processions.

name: All Hallows Eve
description: Exceptional time when the dead may wander into towns.

name: Diana
description: Faerie leader of processions of the dead, collecting the dead and leading them to pagan underworlds.

name: Perchte
description: Faerie leader of processions of the dead, collecting the dead and leading them to pagan underworlds.

name: Frau Holle
description: Faerie leader of processions of the dead, collecting the dead and leading them to pagan underworlds. She is also known to steal naughty children.

name: Ricella
description: Faerie leader of processions of the dead, collecting the dead and leading them to pagan underworlds.

name: Heriodas
description: Faerie leader of processions of the dead, collecting the dead and leading them to pagan underworlds.

name: Herlichinus
description: Demon jester in fool's motley who leads the best-known Infernal procession of punished souls.

name: Beating the Boundaries
description: Procession in which a militia patrols its community and teaches new members the borders of its protectorate.

name: Celebratory Processions
description: Nightwalker feasts and processions where spirits of animals are eaten to regenerate Long Term Fatigue.

name: Night Battle Taboo
description: Taboo forbidding nightwalkers and Infernal witches from speaking of their night battles, on pain of dream beatings.

name: Northern Italy
description: Region where the benandanti are found and nightwalkers break Infernal curses.

name: Fennel
description: Potently magical herb that repels disease demons and witches; the weapon of the benandanti.

name: Prometheus
description: Titan who stole fire from the gods and hid it in a fennel stalk.

name: Theft of Fire
description: Prometheus's theft of fire, which some magi think changed the relationship between Magic and Faerie.

name: Ember Days
description: Four seasonal fasts of the western Church whose Thursdays are when the benandanti fight; kresniks also battle then.

name: Sorghum
description: Plant used as weapons by the malandanti.

name: Lady of the Game
description: Anonymous powerful magical spirit in the form of a woman who leads nightwalker processions, appoints captains and resurrects eaten animals.

name: Transformed Animal
description: Virtue granted to animals returned stronger after being eaten by a northern nightwalker tradition.

name: Aristeas
description: Ancient Greek poet and powerful straying magician serving Apollo, who keeps returning from death via his kolossos.

name: Apollo
description: Greek god whom Aristeas serves, accompanied by ravens in Arcadia.

name: Pliny
description: Ancient author who wrote about Aristeas and his kolossos.

name: Herodotus
description: Ancient historian who wrote about Aristeas.

name: Arcadia
description: Where Aristeas dwells as one of Apollo's ravens.

name: Titanomachy
description: The war of the Titans and Greek Gods; a place of power from before it holds magical weapons.

name: Kolossos
description: Stone buried in place of an absent body, acting as an Arcane Connection anchoring the spirit; Aristeas's is a statue with a raven emerging from his mouth.

name: Arno
description: Benandante companion, a young smith who fights with a club of fennel.

name: Craftsman
description: Trait possessed by the benandante Arno.

name: Tough
description: Trait possessed by the benandante Arno.

name: Close Family Ties
description: Trait possessed by the benandante Arno.

name: Venus' Blessing
description: Virtue replacing Sense Holiness and Unholiness when Arno is redesigned as a malandante.

name: Magic Might
description: Might score of Magic-realm beings; Arno as a weak ghost gets Magic Might 10.

name: Skinchanger
description: Virtue of lycanthropes who take the form of an animal.

name: Shapeshifter
description: Virtue of lycanthropes who take animal or hybrid forms.

name: Hamr
description: Virtue allowing the projection of an animalistic phantasticum at a distance after a trance.

name: Werewolves
description: Many forms exist in Mythic Europe; the Hounds of God are werewolves who besiege Hell.

name: Toasting Ritual
description: Rite by which a Hound of God passes his power to one who toasts his health, blowing three times across the bottle.

name: Hell
description: Raided by the Hounds of God three times a year to recapture stolen seeds; entered by traveling to the end of the sea.

name: Infernal Sentries
description: Guardians of Hell who fight the Hounds of God with iron batons.

name: Poland
description: Area with German minorities where Hounds of God are found.

name: Rothiger
description: Hound of God companion, an itinerant laborer werewolf with red hair who loves to kill in wolf form.

name: Wanderer
description: Trait possessed by the Hound of God Rothiger (human or wolf form).

name: Intuition
description: Trait possessed by the Hound of God Rothiger (human or wolf form).

name: Improved Characteristics
description: Trait possessed by the Hound of God Rothiger (human or wolf form).

name: Ferocity
description: Trait possessed by the Hound of God Rothiger (human or wolf form).

description: Trait possessed by the Hound of God Rothiger (human or wolf form).

name: Sharp Ears
description: Trait possessed by the Hound of God Rothiger (human or wolf form).

name: Infamous
description: Trait possessed by the Hound of God Rothiger (human or wolf form).

name: Kresniki
description: Slavic nightwalkers, each a community's protector, fighting kudlaki with dappled phantastica.

name: Kudlaki
description: Slavic sorcerer nightwalkers who steal a community's fertility and become vampires after death.

name: Vampires
description: Undead form a dead kudlak becomes; repelled by hawthorn.

name: Hawthorn
description: Plant that repels vampires; a hawthorn stake prevents a kudlak's return.

name: Wealthy
description: Kudlaks that defeat their kresnik gain this Virtue until the next battle.

name: Corsica
description: Island home of the mazzeri tradition.

name: Asphodel
description: Plant connected to the dead, used as weapons by mazzeri and sacred to Persephone.

name: Carna
description: Ancient Roman goddess who protected a princeling from vampires with hawthorn.

name: Crown of Thorns
description: Hawthorn crown placed on Jesus's brow, symbol of His sacrifice.

name: Ovid
description: Roman poet who reported hawthorn use against vampires.

name: Persephone
description: Queen of the Underworld, to whom asphodel is sacred.

name: Fields of Asphodel
description: Where the Greeks thought most spirits in Hades dwelled.

name: Hungary
description: Land of the taltós, converted to Christianity centuries ago.

name: Pharmacopeians
description: Tradition of which taltós are suggested as a regional variant.

name: House Tremere
description: Hermetic House that competed with taltós for apprentices, holds a Certamen Focus, and used nightwalkers in the Schism War.

name: House Criamon
description: Hermetic House that moved the Axis Magica and has the Path of Seeming; hopes to find a Magyar shaman.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House that would probably aid the Lady of the Game.

name: Axis Magica
description: Magical axis moved by House Criamon, contributing to the waning of the taltós tradition.

name: Magyar Shamans
description: Pagan Hungarian shamans with the full taltós powers, including immortality until their Mystery passes on.

name: Half Taltós
description: Minor Virtue for a young taltós who fails his initiatory fight.

name: Great Tree
description: The tree that holds the world together, climbed by taltós in vision quests to reach other worlds.

name: Flame Shape
description: Taltós phantastic form as a ball or wheel of flame, physically like an elemental of Might 10.

name: Mythic Companions
description: Powerful companion characters; some nightwalker traditions provide characters of sufficient power.

name: Gifted Companions
description: Gifted characters who might be inducted into the Order, including Gifted nightwalkers.

name: Certamen
description: Hermetic ritual duel, actually based on the spiritual battles of nightwalkers and Lappish shamans.

name: Bonisagus
description: Founder believed to have received Thessalian magic for certamen from Trianoma or Viea.

name: Trianoma
description: Figure believed to have given Thessalian magic to Bonisagus.

name: Viea
description: Trianoma's sister, a historical figure with no love for the Order.

name: Thessalian Magic
description: Magic magi wrongly believe certamen descends from.

name: Laplander Shamans
description: Shamans who battle in phantastic form, suffering fatigue; the true origin of certamen.

name: Twilight
description: Hermetic experience; shaman collisions provoke something similar, and vitkir experience Nátt-thel instead.

name: Focus (Certamen)
description: House Tremere's House Virtue, expressing Insight into nightwalking.

name: Major Breakthrough
description: Research achievement needed to extend certamen to true nightwalking.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Art mentioned in determining a Hermetic nightwalker's corporeal phantasticum shape.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Art mentioned in determining a Hermetic nightwalker's corporeal phantasticum shape.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Art mentioned in determining a Hermetic nightwalker's corporeal phantasticum shape.

name: Imaginem
description: Hermetic Art mentioned in determining a Hermetic nightwalker's corporeal phantasticum shape.

name: Path of Seeming
description: Criamon Path whose senior magi can spirit travel but not generate a phantasticum.

name: Cave of Twisting Shadows
description: Criamon domus magna, near which a shamanic tradition originated.

name: Muscaria
description: Current prima of House Criamon, named after an intoxicating mushroom.

name: Pythagoras
description: Greek philosopher able to seem in two cities at once; linked to ekstasis.

name: Station of Passing Through Seeming
description: Station of the Path of Seeming relevant to Breakthroughs into nightwalking.

name: Path of Walking Backwards
description: Violent Criamon Path that may develop certamen-based nightwalking.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Hermetic ritual protecting covenants that does not hold back Might-less nightwalkers.

name: Schism War
description: War during which House Tremere used nightwalkers to good effect.

name: Seekers
description: Magi who hunted immortal Magyar shamans.

name: Diedne
description: Historical figure with no love for the Order.

name: Dominion
description: Divine influence the Lady of the Game helps spread.

name: Adulteration
description: A psychic shadow of a Criamon magus.

name: Enigma
description: Criamon mystery whose answer requires gathering missing Primi.

name: Vitkir
description: Norse rune wizards, Gifted hedge magicians who carve runes; singular vitki.

name: Runes
description: The 24 runes of the vitkir, Accelerated Abilities used to craft magical effects.

name: Ultima Thule
description: Latin name for the utmost north.

name: Scandinavia
description: Region where vitkar rune magic spread.

name: Denmark

name: Rune Magic

name: Artes Liberales
description: Academic Ability vitkir don't need to read runes.

name: Vitki
description: Free Social Status Virtue required of all vitkir.

name: Damhan-Allaidh
description: Enemy in war against the Order.

name: Oath of Hermes
description: The Hermetic Oath stating that the enemies of the Order are my enemies.

name: Seithr
description: Viking women's witchcraft taught by Gullveig.

name: Gullveig
description: Wicked giantess who taught seithr.
